scripts.check-webhook: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Telegraf} = require('telegraf'); const bot = new Telegraf(process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN); bot.telegram.getWebhookInfo().then(info => console.log(JSON.stringify(info, null, 2)));"
scripts.delete-webhook: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {Telegraf} = require('telegraf'); const bot = new Telegraf(process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN); bot.telegram.deleteWebhook().then(() => console.log('✅ Webhook eliminado'));"
